blocks.name: Assertion
blocks.maskDescription:
Assert that the input signal is non-zero. The default behavior in the absence of a callback is to output an error message when the assertion fails.

When generating a DPI-C component this block gets translated into a native SystemVerilog assertion that throws the specified assertion fail message or executes the specified SystemVerilog command if 'custom' severity is selected.

blocks.name: Sequence Feedback
blocks.maskDescription: Use this block as a feedback connection from the scoreboard to the sequence in the UVM testbench model. This block is a unit delay with initial condition 0.
